items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 241:1
items.html: They are the sparks of the heel, which are the holy sparks that remained of the thirty-two sparks and have no clarification before the completion of the correction. They are called Jacob, for they are remnants of the three-within-three of Assiyah — that is, until the completion of the correction there can be clarified, from the aspect of the aforementioned MA of Malchut, only the aspect of the Aviut of the root, which brings out only the stature of Malchut; and from the aspect of the correction of the lines it is called NNH, so the first nine are found missing from her, and they are considered by the name of remnants of the three-within-three. And they will not be clarified completely until the future, when the Malchut of Radla is revealed in the secret of "the stone that the builders rejected has become the head cornerstone." (Item 138).
